SEC. 1622. EXTENSION OF AUTHORITY TO ENGAGE IN CERTAIN COMMERCIAL 
                          ACTIVITIES.

    Section 431(a) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``December 31, 2017'' and inserting ``December 31, 2023''.
